summary: The consolidation component is the loop's memory-consolidation ('sleep') system. On an interval the ConsolidationEngine collects recent episodes via ShortTermCollector, compacts them with MemoryCompactor (LLM summarization), deduplicates near-identical memories, establishes causal links, and writes durable TemporalRecords with decay scores into a LongTermStore, emitting a ConsolidationReport. It runs off the hot path: it transforms transient EpisodeData into consolidated long-term memory that later perceive stages retrieve, reshaping the loop's memory budget over time rather than per-iteration.
context_basis: Recommendations were formed reading src/consolidation/ (mod ConsolidationEngine, collector, compactor, store, temporal, config) in the context of the full engine at a ~600k budget framing, where consolidation runs periodically to convert episodes into long-term memory.

examples.title: Collect recent episodes for consolidation
examples.intent: Gather episodes eligible for consolidation by age and importance.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: ShortTermCollector.collect_episodes filters EpisodeData into CollectedItems, defining the working set the sleep cycle will process.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Flick recent episode chips into the consolidation node to queue them.
touch_interaction.visual: Episodes stream in as small cards; those below the importance floor gray out and drop.

examples.mini_scenario: The sleep cycle wakes and collect_episodes pulls episodes newer than max_age and above min_importance into a batch.
examples.pitfall: Filter by both age and importance; consolidating trivial episodes wastes LLM tokens on noise.

examples.title: Assemble a batch to summarize
examples.intent: Group collected items into a CollectedBatch sized for one compaction pass.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: assemble_batch bundles CollectedItems by batch_size so compaction operates on coherent chunks within the concurrency budget.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Pinch collected item cards together to form a batch bundle.
touch_interaction.visual: Items snap into a stacked batch card showing its item count and estimated tokens.

examples.mini_scenario: assemble_batch groups twenty CollectedItems into a CollectedBatch that the compactor summarizes in one LLM call.
examples.pitfall: Size batches to the summary token budget; oversized batches truncate or overflow the summarization prompt.

examples.title: Compact episodes into a summary
examples.intent: Distill a batch of episodes into CompactedContent.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: MemoryCompactor summarizes a CollectedBatch into CompactedContent, shrinking many episodes into one dense memory to save long-term budget.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Double-tap the compactor node to preview the summary it produced.
touch_interaction.visual: The batch card collapses into a single glowing summary card with an estimated-tokens badge.

examples.mini_scenario: A batch of debugging episodes is compacted into a single CompactedContent capturing the root cause and fix.
examples.pitfall: Preserve the salient facts, not just length reduction; a summary that drops the key insight defeats consolidation.

examples.title: Deduplicate near-identical memories
examples.intent: Avoid storing multiple copies of the same knowledge.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: Consolidation drops records above the dedup_similarity threshold, keeping the LongTermStore compact so retrieval stays sharp.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Spread the store node to see clusters of similar records with duplicates flagged.
touch_interaction.visual: Near-duplicate records cluster; the kept one glows while duplicates fade with a merge arrow.

examples.mini_scenario: Two consolidations of the same recurring task produce near-identical records; the second is dropped as a duplicate.
examples.pitfall: Set dedup_similarity carefully; too high keeps redundant memories, too low merges genuinely distinct ones.

examples.title: Assign importance to records
examples.intent: Rank consolidated memories so key ones survive pruning.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: RecordImportance tiers TemporalRecords, letting the store prioritize what to keep as memory budget tightens.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Long-press a record to adjust its importance tier.
touch_interaction.visual: Records render at heights by tier; high-importance ones sit tall with a star badge.

examples.mini_scenario: A record capturing a critical architectural decision is tagged high importance so it resists decay and pruning.
examples.pitfall: Do not over-promote; if everything is high importance, importance can no longer guide pruning.

examples.title: Apply time decay to relevance
examples.intent: Let old, unused memories fade in retrieval ranking.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: decay_score_at applies decay_half_life_hours so a TemporalRecord's relevance drops over time unless refreshed by access.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Pinch the timeline to watch decay scores age across records.
touch_interaction.visual: Records dim and shrink as their decay score falls; recently accessed ones re-brighten.

examples.mini_scenario: An old record's decay_score_at drops below the useful threshold, so it ranks low in the next retrieval.
examples.pitfall: Weight decay against importance; a critical old memory should decay slower than a trivial recent one.

examples.title: Refresh a record on access
examples.intent: Keep frequently-used memories fresh.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: record_access updates a TemporalRecord's access metadata, boosting its decay score so useful memories persist across sleep cycles.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Tap a retrieved record to reinforce it; its access count ticks up.
touch_interaction.visual: The tapped record pulses brighter and its freshness ring refills.

examples.mini_scenario: A record retrieved during a task calls record_access, so it survives the next decay pass instead of fading.
examples.pitfall: Reinforce on genuine use, not incidental scans; over-reinforcing pins stale records artificially.

examples.title: Establish causal links between memories
examples.intent: Connect a cause memory to its effect memory.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: Consolidation records causal_links so the perceive stage can traverse from a symptom memory to its known cause.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Draw an edge between two record cards to assert a causal link.
touch_interaction.visual: A directed cause->effect arrow forms; linked records share a highlight when either is selected.

examples.mini_scenario: Consolidation links a 'config change' record to a 'test failure' record so future retrieval surfaces the cause.
examples.pitfall: Only link real causation; spurious links pollute retrieval with misleading associations.

examples.title: Preserve multimodal references
examples.intent: Keep pointers to images or artifacts alongside text summaries.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: Consolidation retains multimodal_refs so a compacted memory can still surface its screenshot or artifact on retrieval.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Double-tap a record to expand its attached multimodal thumbnails.
touch_interaction.visual: Small thumbnail chips fan out beneath the record's text summary.

examples.mini_scenario: A UI-debugging episode is compacted but its screenshot reference is preserved so the memory stays visually grounded.
examples.pitfall: Store references, not copies, of large artifacts; embedding raw media bloats the store.

examples.title: Write records to the long-term store
examples.intent: Persist consolidated memories for future retrieval.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: LongTermStore writes TemporalRecords (optionally embedded) and returns a StoreResult, moving knowledge from volatile episodes to durable memory.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Flick a finished summary card into the store to persist it.
touch_interaction.visual: The card slides into the store node and leaves a persisted-checkmark marker.

examples.mini_scenario: After compaction, the engine writes the TemporalRecord to LongTermStore and the StoreResult confirms persistence.
examples.pitfall: Persist atomically; a partial write during the sleep cycle can leave the store inconsistent.

examples.title: Query stored memory by tag
examples.intent: Retrieve consolidated memories relevant to the current task.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: query_by_tag pulls matching TemporalRecords into the perceive stage, injecting durable knowledge back into the loop.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Tap a tag chip on the store to pull matching records into the context tray.
touch_interaction.visual: Matching records light up and slide into a context tray at the canvas edge.

examples.mini_scenario: Starting a database task, query_by_tag('db') returns past consolidated db-migration memories into context.
examples.pitfall: Rank retrieved records by decay+importance; dumping all tag matches floods the context budget.

examples.title: Run consolidation on a schedule
examples.intent: Consolidate memory off the hot path at intervals.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: start_periodic spawns a background task that runs consolidation every interval_secs, so memory upkeep never blocks the main loop.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Rotate the interval dial on the consolidation node to set the sleep cadence.
touch_interaction.visual: A clock ring on the node ticks toward the next cycle; it pulses moon-blue while consolidating.

examples.mini_scenario: start_periodic runs every hour; between cycles the main loop is unaffected while memory quietly consolidates.
examples.pitfall: Keep consolidation off the hot path; running it synchronously stalls the loop during summarization.

examples.title: Cap concurrent LLM summarization
examples.intent: Limit parallel summarization to protect the endpoint and budget.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: max_concurrent_llm bounds how many batches summarize at once, keeping the sleep cycle within its token and rate budget.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Pinch the fanout edges to set how many batches summarize in parallel.
touch_interaction.visual: Active summarization lanes glow; queued batches wait dimmed behind the concurrency cap.

examples.mini_scenario: With max_concurrent_llm=3, only three batches summarize at once while the rest queue, respecting the rate limit.
examples.pitfall: Do not unbound the fanout; too many concurrent LLM calls trip rate limits and blow the token budget.

examples.title: Emit a consolidation report
examples.intent: Summarize what one sleep cycle accomplished.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: ConsolidationReport records episodes_processed, records_produced, duplicates_removed, and tokens_used so the loop can verify the cycle's cost and yield.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Tap the consolidation node after a cycle to read its report card.
touch_interaction.visual: A report card lists processed/produced/deduped counts and a tokens-used meter.

examples.mini_scenario: A cycle processes 40 episodes into 12 records, removes 8 duplicates, and the report shows the token cost.
examples.pitfall: Watch tokens_used per record; a cycle that spends huge tokens for few records signals oversized batches.

examples.title: Prune episodes after consolidation
examples.intent: Free short-term storage once episodes are safely consolidated.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: prune_after_consolidation removes source episodes once their knowledge is in the LongTermStore, bounding short-term memory growth.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Flick consolidated episode chips into a trash bin to prune them.
touch_interaction.visual: Consolidated episodes gray out with a checkmark, then fade as they are pruned.

examples.mini_scenario: After records are persisted, prune_after_consolidation deletes the source episodes so short-term memory does not grow unbounded.
examples.pitfall: Prune only after successful persistence; deleting episodes before the store write risks losing them on failure.

examples.title: Age out episodes past a horizon
examples.intent: Ignore episodes too old to be worth consolidating.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: max_episode_age_hours bounds which episodes the collector considers, keeping each cycle focused on relevant recent activity.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Pinch the age-horizon slider to set how far back episodes qualify.
touch_interaction.visual: Episodes beyond the horizon slide past a fade line and drop from the queue.

examples.mini_scenario: Episodes older than the age horizon are skipped, so a long-idle backlog does not flood one cycle.
examples.pitfall: Set the horizon relative to your interval; too short skips episodes between cycles and loses them.

examples.title: Estimate token cost before compaction
examples.intent: Predict the summarization cost of a batch.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: CompactedContent.estimated_tokens lets the engine size batches and forecast budget before spending LLM tokens.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Spread a batch card to reveal its estimated token cost bar.
touch_interaction.visual: A token bar fills; batches near the summary limit tint amber as a warning.

examples.mini_scenario: A batch's estimated_tokens nears the summary limit, so the engine splits it before compaction.
examples.pitfall: Estimate before, not after, calling the LLM; discovering overflow post-call wastes the whole request.

examples.title: Track temporal span of a record
examples.intent: Record the time range the memory covers.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: time_span gives a TemporalRecord a start/end window, letting the loop reason about when consolidated knowledge applies.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Long-press a record to see its covered time span on a mini timeline.
touch_interaction.visual: A span bracket highlights the start-to-end window on the record's timeline strip.

examples.mini_scenario: A record consolidating a week of episodes carries a time_span so retrieval can scope to that period.
examples.pitfall: Derive the span from the source episodes, not the write time; the record covers when things happened, not when it was stored.

examples.title: Surface consolidation errors
examples.intent: Know which parts of a cycle failed without aborting the rest.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: ConsolidationReport.errors collects per-item failures so the cycle degrades gracefully and the loop sees what did not consolidate.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Double-tap the report to expand the error list for the cycle.
touch_interaction.visual: Failed items list under a red error section while successful ones stay in the green summary.

examples.mini_scenario: One batch's LLM call times out; its error is recorded in the report while the other batches consolidate successfully.
examples.pitfall: Isolate per-item failures; one bad batch must not abort the whole consolidation cycle.

examples.title: Compose the sleep cycle end to end
examples.intent: Wire collect, compact, dedup, link, store, and report into one background cycle.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: Chains ShortTermCollector -> MemoryCompactor -> dedup/causal-link -> LongTermStore -> ConsolidationReport, running periodically to move episodes into durable memory.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Pinch to collapse the consolidation sub-nodes into one sleep-cycle node with a moon badge.
touch_interaction.visual: Collapsed it shows a moon with the last cycle's yield; spread reveals collector, compactor, dedup, store, and report.

examples.mini_scenario: On its interval the engine collects episodes, compacts and dedups them, links and stores records, then emits a report before the loop's next perceive stage retrieves the fresh memory.
examples.pitfall: Keep the pipeline ordered and off the hot path: collect and compact before store, prune only after persist, and never block the main loop on a cycle.
